title: A host's change of a room's metadata alone goes through patch_room_metadata: a key another writer patches while the change is held stands beside the host's
notes: Python: RoomKit.update_room_metadata (core/mixins/room_lifecycle.py) and tests/test_framework.py::TestConcurrentLocking::test_a_metadata_update_keeps_a_key_another_writer_patched_meanwhile. The fault holds the kit's write in place of whichever of patch_room_metadata and update_room it makes, then runs it on the store as it then stands; meanwhile another writer patches the room's metadata through the store, as the framework's own writers (a channel's state, a detach's revocation) do. That writer adds a key and changes one the room holds: a merge of the host's keys alone keeps both, where a whole-record write, or a patch of every key, from the room read before it would undo them. Not compared: the room the host's call returns.
